question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The money paid to former wife, husband or partner when the marriage is ended.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Alimony**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alimony **refers to a financial support payment that one spouse or former spouse provides to the other during and after a divorce or separation. (एक वित्तीय सहायता भुगतान जो एक पति या पत्नी या पूर्व पति दूसरे को तलाक या अलगाव के दौरान और उसके बाद प्रदान करता है)
 
• Hence, 'Alimony' is the accurate one-word substitute for "the money paid to former spouse after marriage ends."
 
• It is a noun and refers specifically to payments made to a former spouse.
 
• The word comes from the Latin word "**alimonia**" which means nourishment or sustenance.
 
 
• **For example-** *She received a monthly alimony payment of $2,000 from her ex-husband.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Compensation **refers to payment for services rendered or for loss or injury suffered. (प्रदान की गई सेवाओं या हुई हानि या चोट के लिए भुगतान)
 
• **Recompense **also means compensation or payment for services rendered, but can also refer to making amends or making up for a wrong. (प्रदान की गई सेवाओं के लिए मुआवज़ा या भुगतान)
 
• **Maintenance **can refer to regular upkeep or support. (नियमित रखरखाव या समर्थन)
